desc: Read input and build the graph using reverse adjacency lists and in-degree counts.
Perform a topological sort (peeling) to process tree nodes, computing $G(u, V)$ and prefix sums $S(u, V)$ for each node.
Compute $G(u, V)$ and $S(u, V)$ for cycle nodes using values from their processed tree children.
Identify cycles and compute the answer for each component by summing products of $G(c, V)$ over $V$.
Multiply component answers to get the final result modulo 998244353 and print it.
